TryModifyRewards.issue: Rollup of guard G1 per binding rule 4. PrayerWheel.cs:14-26 appends `new CardReward(CardCreationOptions.ForRoom(player, RoomType.Monster), 3, player)` to every Monster room's reward list -- the relic's entire effect -- and the port is a behaviourless stub.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): normal-enemy combats offer ONE card choice instead of two, and the stub's stated premise ('an out-of-combat reward modifier, so this is a no-op stub') is false
guards.issue: MECHANISM: TryModifyRewards is the reward-list mutator, and the relic adds a SECOND independent 3-card reward to Monster rooms. The sim has the hook and calls it: rewards.py:499-500 runs `relic.modify_combat_rewards(run, rewards)` over every relic after the screen is generated, and five other relics already implement it (Lava Rock adds relic rewards to the act-1 boss screen through this very hook). PROMPT.md bug class 12 requires checking the premise before accepting a stub, and the premise is false -- 'out-of-combat' is true and irrelevant, since the sim models the out-of-combat reward screen. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes_b12.py b12-prayer): a MONSTER screen yields cards=['second_wind','vicious','colossus'] and special_cards=0 both with and without the relic; the game yields those three PLUS another three. Both sides ported and nothing further needed: Prayer Wheel is Rare in the transcribed grab bag and every normal-enemy fight produces a reward screen. IMPLEMENTATION NOTES for the fix, because a naive one is wrong twice: (a) rewards.CombatRewards models the card choice as a single `cards` list plus `special_cards`, which the record's own comment describes as INDEPENDENT take-or-skip single-card offers (rewards.py:381-385) -- Prayer Wheel needs a second pick-one-of-THREE group, which the dataclass cannot express today, so this is a field addition and not a one-liner like the other stubs; (b) the second CardReward Populates through the same creation path, so it consumes card-creation draws on the Rewards stream -- an implementation that appends pre-made cards would fix the offer and leave RNG parity broken, and `create_reward_cards` is the function that must be called again. The room filter must stay: `room.RoomType != RoomType.Monster` returns false (PrayerWheel.cs:20-23), and the probe confirms an ELITE screen is unchanged in the game. This is one of the 30 Sweep C stubs whose dropped hook has a live sim dispatch site; .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md lists prayer_wheel first under the 'out-of-combat reward modifier' family. NOTE per binding rule 7: relics/base.py, rewards.py and content-relic-sweeps.md are NOT hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: `if (player != base.Owner) return false;` (PrayerWheel.cs:16-19) and the bool return
guards.rationale: The owner test is multiplayer scoping: the sim has one player and rewards.py dispatches modify_combat_rewards over run.relics for that player, so it is structurally satisfied. The `bool` return is TryModifyRewards' 'did I change anything' signal, which the game uses to decide whether to re-render; the sim's hook returns None and mutates in place (relics/base.py:168-170), which is the house shape for this hook family and carries no observable. Recorded so the fix does not try to reproduce the return value.

guards.what: N2: `new CardReward(CardCreationOptions.ForRoom(player, RoomType.Monster), 3, player)` -- the count is a literal 3 and there is no CanonicalVars block
guards.rationale: PrayerWheel.cs is 27 lines with no CanonicalVars and no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension, so 3 is the pinned non-ascension option count and it matches the sim's own normal card-reward width (ROOM_RARITY_ODDS-driven groups of three; the probe prints 3 options on every screen). The port pins no constant at all today, so there is nothing for PROMPT.md bug class 19 to catch -- but a fix must use 3 and the Monster-room creation options, not the options of the room actually being resolved: `CardCreationOptions.ForRoom(player, RoomType.Monster)` is hard-coded to Monster even though the enclosing guard has already established the room IS a Monster room, so the two agree today and would still agree if the guard were ever relaxed.
